content:
A goat.
A photo from a walk on 15 June, 2024.
📷 OM-D E-M5 & 45 mm ƒ1.8, shot at ƒ8.

photos.alt: A photo of a goat, standing in a field of grass and yellow flowers. The goat is brown with white, is on a chain, and looks into the camera. Where the goat stands, big patches of dirt can be seen between the grass.
